automation_scripts_rules.description: Rule for one-to-one mapping between test steps and automation script lines, including intermediary steps.
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test steps with direct one-to-one mapping to script lines as per correlation.
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step from the manual test case directly maps to a single automation script line in the correlation.
THEN: Implement the automation using the mapped script line.
IMPLEMENTATION: For each such test step, follow the exact mapped script line and execute all intermediary steps in the listed order. Do not skip or merge steps.

automation_scripts_rules.description: Rule for implicit and supporting steps required for test case execution and validation.
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All implicit steps labeled as 'Required for Test Execution' or 'Supporting Step – Purpose of Test Case Validation' in the correlation for test case 'Verify the behavior, when user Enables the 'Print' destination toggle bar in 'Add Shortcut' screen.'
rule_definition: WHEN: Automating test cases of type 'Verify the behavior, when user Enables the 'Print' destination toggle bar in 'Add Shortcut' screen.'
THEN: You MUST include all implicit/supporting steps identified in the correlation, even if not present in the manual test steps.

IMPLEMENTATION: For each implicit/supporting step, implement the mapped script line and all its intermediary steps. These steps are required to fulfill the purpose of the test case and ensure validation. Do not omit these steps.

automation_scripts_rules.description: For each test step in the test case, implement the mapped automation script line in the exact order as listed. For steps labeled as 'Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution' or 'Supporting Step – Purpose of Test Case Validation', these must always be included even if not present in the manual test steps, as they are required for correct test execution and validation.
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test steps, including implicit and supporting steps, for the test case 'Verify the screen when the user enables only the 'Save' destination in the 'Add Shortcut' screen.'
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step from the test case or an implicit/supporting step is encountered in the correlation mapping.
THEN: Implement the mapped script line for that step, in the exact sequence provided. Do not skip implicit or supporting steps.

IMPLEMENTATION: For each step, use the mapped script line. For any intermediary steps provided, implement them in the order listed. For implicit/supporting steps, always include them even if not present in the manual test steps, as they are required for test execution and validation. Do not merge or skip steps.

rule_1_one_to_one_mapping.description: When a test step maps to exactly one script line, document the direct mapping with all intermediary steps required for execution.
validation_criteria: Each test step must map to exactly one script line
All intermediary steps must be documented in execution order
Script line must be executable and validated
Intermediary steps must bridge test intent to script execution

rule_2_one_to_many_mapping.description: When a test step maps to multiple script lines, split into sub-steps (e.g., 1a, 1b, 1c) where each sub-step maps to exactly one script line with its intermediary steps. Execution order must be strictly enforced.
validation_criteria: Original test step must be split into sub-steps with alphabetic suffixes
Each sub-step maps to exactly one script line
All intermediary steps for each sub-step must be documented
Execution order across sub-steps must be sequential and enforced
No script line from original mapping can be omitted
Sub-step labels must follow pattern: [step_number][a-z]

example_pattern.original_test_step: Step N: [complex action requiring multiple scripts]

rule_3_purpose_supporting_steps.description: Steps labeled as 'Implicit Step – Supporting Step – Purpose of Test Case Validation' must be included to validate the test case purpose. These steps are critical for test integrity and must not be omitted.
validation_criteria: Step must be explicitly labeled as supporting/purpose validation
Must reference the test_case_name
Must map to specific script line(s)
Must include all intermediary steps
Must include justification for inclusion
These steps validate the core purpose of the test case

structure.step_label: Implicit Step – Supporting Step – Purpose of Test Case Validation

example_pattern.step_label: Implicit Step – Supporting Step – Purpose of Test Case Validation
example_pattern.justification: This step validates [specific purpose] which is the core objective of the test case

rule_4_execution_order_enforcement.description: All steps, sub-steps, and intermediary steps must follow strict sequential execution order. No step can execute before its predecessor completes.
validation_criteria: Steps must execute in numerical order
Sub-steps must execute in alphabetical order within their parent step
Intermediary steps must execute in array order
No parallel execution unless explicitly documented
Each step must complete before next step begins

rule_5_completeness_validation.description: Every test step, script line, and intermediary step from the correlation and intermediary_steps arrays must be included in the rules. No omissions allowed.
validation_criteria: All entries from correlation_steps_to_scripts must be mapped
All entries from intermediary_steps must be included
No test steps can be skipped
No script lines can be omitted
No intermediary steps can be excluded
Split steps must account for all original mappings

rule_6_reusability_and_standardization.description: All rules must be reusable across test cases and automation scripts. Patterns must be standardized for future automation consistency.
validation_criteria: Rules must be pattern-based, not case-specific
Structure must be consistent across all mappings
Naming conventions must be standardized
Rules must be applicable to future test cases
Documentation must enable automation without human interpretation

rule_7_intermediary_step_requirements.description: Intermediary steps bridge the gap between test intent and script execution. Every mapping must include complete intermediary steps in execution order.
validation_criteria: Intermediary steps must be documented as arrays
Steps must be in execution order
Each intermediary step must be actionable
Intermediary steps must logically connect test step to script line
No intermediary step can be implicit or assumed

rule_8_split_step_documentation.description: When test steps are split into sub-steps for one-to-many mappings, the split must be fully documented with clear parent-child relationships and execution order.
validation_criteria: Parent step must be clearly identified
All sub-steps must reference parent
Sub-step labels must follow [parent_number][letter] pattern
Each sub-step must have complete documentation
Execution order across sub-steps must be explicit
Justification for split must be documented

rule_9_validation_and_quality_assurance.description: All generated rules and mappings must pass validation checks before being committed. This ensures data integrity and automation readiness.
validation_checks: JSON structure is valid and minified
No null or undefined values in critical fields
Execution order is logical and sequential

rule_10_future_automation_consistency.description: Rules must ensure consistency for future automation efforts. All patterns, structures, and documentation must enable automated script generation without ambiguity.
requirements: No ambiguous language or implicit assumptions
future_use_cases: Automated script generation from test cases
